note: Style tags the brand profiler and digest builder may use. The AI picks 3-5 per brand from this list only. 'id' is the stable key in code; 'label' is what users see; 'cues' are words in a brand's own text that suggest the tag.

tags.label: Quiet luxury
tags.definition: Logo-free, high-quality basics in muted tones.

tags.label: Old money
tags.definition: Preppy, heritage-club dressing: cable knits, loafers, polos.

tags.label: Minimalist
tags.definition: Clean lines, neutral palette, few details.

tags.label: Scandi
tags.definition: Nordic minimalism with playful color or volume.

tags.label: Parisian chic
tags.definition: Effortless French staples: Breton stripes, trench, red lip.

tags.label: Office siren
tags.definition: Sharp, body-conscious workwear: pencil skirts, slim shirts, rimless glasses.

tags.label: Tailored
tags.definition: Structured suiting and precise fits.

tags.label: Balletcore
tags.definition: Ballet references: flats, wrap tops, tulle, soft pinks.

tags.label: Coquette
tags.definition: Hyper-feminine bows, lace, ruffles and pastels.

tags.label: Romantic
tags.definition: Soft, flowing femininity: florals, puff sleeves, sheer layers.

tags.label: Boho
tags.definition: Free-spirited 70s-leaning: suede, fringe, crochet, prairie.

tags.label: Cottagecore
tags.definition: Rural idyll: prairie dresses, gingham, smocking.

tags.label: Coastal

tags.label: Resort

tags.label: Y2K

tags.label: 90s minimal

tags.label: Indie sleaze

tags.label: Grunge

tags.label: Streetwear

tags.label: Athleisure

tags.label: Blokecore

tags.label: Workwear

tags.label: Western

tags.label: Preppy

tags.label: Mob wife

tags.label: Maximalist
tags.definition: Bold prints, clashing color, more is more.

tags.definition: Seoul street-minimal: oversized, layered neutrals.
